description: PROPOSED, awaiting agreement and native declaration contract. Extend existing Zaq.System and System.Config storage for singleton JSON key, existing Engine.Api system-config family with confidential identified BO management authorization, and separately justified runtime read contract. Reuse FileSettings conversion/merge/Ecto/errors, existing transaction/upsert machinery, and final native proposal snapshot validation; no new module/Action/parallel validator/ChannelConfig row. Keep actor scope, unknown limits, conditional requirements and failure policy intact. Tests first in existing System/Engine suites: exact bytes, optional whitespace clearing, supported numeric/required rules, rollback and final proposed values, unauthorized/nil actor, singleton/concurrent behavior, widget isolation. Follow parent reuse evidence, docs and validation lifecycle.

comments.text: System singleton storage and guarded Engine operations implemented. Native read/save retain exactly one System.Config JSON key, normalize through FileSettings, snapshot the final merged proposal and validate through existing Ecto-backed FileSettings immediately before existing System.set_config upsert. Transaction inserts a missing row with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING and locks it before reading/merging, so partial writers serialize; rejected first saves roll back even the seed row. Corrupt storage and capability failures return bounded errors. Original System/Engine tests (135 checks, 2 properties) passed /tmp/zaq-native-persistence.log, mix q passed /tmp/zaq-native-persistence-q.log. Read/save Engine handlers explicitly require confidential current BO actor; no connector IDs/store keys accepted as configuration fields. No new validator/module/Action or transport implementation.

title: [zaq-h2i.4.1] Persist native BO-chat settings in existing System owners
